description:
We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer / Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) for our fully remote team who takes full ownership of our servers: building them, monitoring them and scaling them. You keep the whole picture in view and make sure our systems work together reliably. You don't need to know our stack in advance. We're looking for someone who has built and run critical distributed systems before.

About Us

Hausverwalter.ai is an all-in-one platform for property management companies with features like an Inbox, CRM, Documents, Telephony, Video Calls, Team Chat and AI-Agents. We want to automate as much of a property manager's daily work as we can.

What you'll do

  • Own our production servers end to end: setup, uptime, monitoring, alerting, backups and capacity. When an alert fires, you're the one who handles it.

  • Find bottlenecks in RAM, I/O and latency before they become a problem for our customers

  • Think in failure scenarios and build real high availability: failover, replication and backups that are actually tested

  • Scale the setup as we grow, without over-engineering on day one

  • Keep the whole system in view and work closely with our developers on anything that affects load

  • Document how everything works and what happened after every incident, so the whole team can follow

  • Work independently in an AI-first setup with Claude: for design, automation scripts, debugging and documentation

Our tech stack

Everything is TypeScript. From our database schema to the frontend.

Backend: Convex (Database & serverless functions)

Frontend: Next.js, React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui

Salary

  • $2500 - $4000 per month before taxes with room for growth and promotion in the months & years ahead

  • Permanent employment contract in your country of residence through our partner Deel (EOR)

  • Full-time, permanent position. No freelance or contractor setup.

Benefits

  • 100% remote work

  • Allianz Gold Health Insurance with great coverage

  • Flexible hours

  • As many AI-tokens as you need

  • We’re self-funded & profitable (and not burning VC money to survive)

  • Small team, real ownership — what you build actually goes live

  • Quick decisions, no pointless meetings and no layers of approval to get through

Our special Health Program

  • Private room in hospital, worldwide coverage

  • Free choice of doctors & specialists, no health check, pre-existing conditions don't matter

  • Partner and kids are covered as well

  • Surgery, cancer care, MRI/CT/PET scans and diagnostics fully covered

  • Dental treatment & surgery covered at 90%

  • $675/year for physio, osteopathy, chiropractic and acupuncture

  • $100 per night in-patient cash benefit, up to 20 nights

  • Prescription drugs, vaccinations, glasses/contacts, home nursing and ambulance covered

Our core principles

  • Speed of implementation: we ship fast. A first version goes live early and gets better with customer feedback.

  • Radical honesty: we say openly what is true, within the team and to our customers. Especially when it is uncomfortable.

  • High standards for our own work and each other's

For a closer look at what we're building, check out our YouTube channel — heads up, it's in German.


  • Fluent English

  • Senior-level experience building, running and troubleshooting distributed systems on Linux servers, bare metal and cloud

  • Hands-on experience with high availability: failover, replication, sharding, and the split-brain problems that come with them

  • Deep PostgreSQL experience: administration, tuning, connection pooling, replication and disaster recovery. You have actually restored a database from a backup, not just configured one.

  • Strong with containers and infrastructure as code: Docker, Kubernetes or Nomad, Terraform or Ansible

  • You set up observability before it's needed: Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager

  • You use AI tools like Claude or Cursor every day for architecture, scripts, debugging and documentation

  • Reliable and pragmatic: when you say something is done, it's done and tested. You build what's needed now, prepare for what comes next and don't over-engineer on day one.

  • You're used to running critical production systems on your own and taking full responsibility for them
